about: Alignment test, Version 1: for fun and self-reflection, scored entirely in the visitor's browser. Items are DRAFTS written by Claude for Ryan to review and rewrite in his own words. Each axis has 16 items, 8 keyed in each direction. 'key': +1 means agreeing pushes toward Chaotic (order axis) or Good (heart axis); -1 means agreeing pushes toward Lawful or Evil.

items.text: I feel calmer when there's a clear plan to follow.
It bothers me when someone is treated unfairly, even if it doesn't affect me.
I often make it up as I go, and it usually works out.
If a deal works out in my favor, it isn't my job to make it fair.
Rules usually exist for good reasons, even when I can't see them right away.
I help people even when no one will ever know I did.
A rule that makes no sense to me isn't one I feel bound to follow.
Looking out for myself comes before looking out for others.
Traditions are worth keeping, even when they feel old-fashioned.
Everyone deserves kindness, no matter their status.
I get restless when every day looks the same.
Some people just aren't worth the trouble of helping.
People in charge usually got there for a reason.
I'd rather lose a deal than win it by taking advantage of someone.
Titles and uniforms don't earn my respect on their own.
Bending the truth is fine if it gets me what I want.
I'd rather follow a proven method than experiment with a new one.
The well-being of people I'll never meet matters to me.
When a plan falls apart, part of me gets a little excited.
If someone is careless with their things, it's their own fault if they lose them.
Things run best when everyone knows their role.
I go out of my way to make newcomers feel welcome.
The best ideas come from breaking with how things have always been done.
Getting ahead sometimes means stepping on a few toes.
When a rule is broken, there should be consequences, no exceptions.
Sharing what I have feels better than keeping it.
I'd rather ask forgiveness than permission.
Being nice is mostly useful for getting people on your side.
Once I commit to a routine, I stick to it.
I'd give up something I want if it meant someone else got what they needed.
Schedules are more like suggestions to me.
Other people's problems aren't mine to lose sleep over.

lawful-good.name: Lawful Good
lawful-good.desc: Ah, a champion of laws and justice. Your sense of order is as keen as your moral compass. You're the one friends call when trouble knocks, and you never hesitate to carry the torch into the dark. Yet, don't forget: rules can be bent just a tad if it means saving the day or having some fun. After all, how could one throw a surprise party or keep confidence of a friend without withholding truth but for a moment?

neutral-good.name: Neutral Good
neutral-good.desc: You don't care about crowns or chains; you care about what's right. You've a knack for finding the middle path, and helping without making a spectacle. Your compassion drives you, but you won't get mired in squabbles over order or chaos. The coin you carry isn't weighted by rules kept or rules broken, just by the weight of helping hands. That's a wonderful thing, but don't be afraid to enjoy a bit of trickery now and then.

chaotic-good.name: Chaotic Good
chaotic-good.desc: You are a whirlwind of freedom with a heart of gold. You follow your conscience, not dusty rules written by harrowed hands. When something isn't right, you fix it despite procedure or policy. Your mischief might fluster the “proper” folk, but those you help smile a little brighter. Keep dancing to your own song; the world needs your unpredictable kindness.

lawful-neutral.name: Lawful Neutral
lawful-neutral.desc: You, my friend, are the steady hand that keeps the ledger balanced. Duty and tradition guide you more than any flashy notion of “good” or “evil.” You see the world as a set of gears in motion, and you keep them turning even when others squabble about why. There's something reassuring in your predictability, but take care not to become too rigid. Even clocks have their spring days when they tick a little off beat.

true-neutral.name: True Neutral
true-neutral.desc: You are the elusive master of balance. You've learned to stand in the center and weigh both sides, never tipping too far. Some call you indecisive, but you're simply mindful of the scales. You step in when needed and step away when not, keeping harmony without playing favorites. Just remember, neutrality doesn't mean ignoring your own heart's desires.

chaotic-neutral.name: Chaotic Neutral
chaotic-neutral.desc: Ah, a true free spirit! You blow like the wind: uncatchable, ever-changing. You answer to no one but your own curiosity and whims. On occasion it's admirable. Others might find your unpredictability maddening, but it keeps them on their toes. Just be sure your escapades leave at least a few bridges unburnt, for yourself and your fellow mischief-makers.

lawful-evil.name: Lawful Evil
lawful-evil.desc: You are a master of structure, and perhaps too skilled at shaping it to suit your wants. You've learned how to climb systems by tightening rules around others while loosening them for yourself. It works, right up until people realize your order is merely a velvet-wrapped cage placed over their choices. Your careful composure can make you powerful, but it can also make you profoundly lonely. After all, control can win compliance, but it rarely wins trust… and trust is the one currency no empire thrives without.

neutral-evil.name: Neutral Evil
neutral-evil.desc: You choose whichever path profits you most, stepping lightly around inconvenience and responsibility alike. It's clever in the moment, yes, but every shortcut you take often sends someone else tumbling into the long way around. You gather advantages quickly, but you lose support just as fast, leaving you surrounded by opportunities and conspicuously short on allies. When everything is transactional, everyone becomes disposable, including you. You may win the game for a while, but the victory feels hollow when there's no one left to celebrate with you.

chaotic-evil.name: Chaotic Evil
chaotic-evil.desc: You burn hot and bright, lashing out at limits simply because they exist. Your impulses can feel intoxicating, but the fallout they create scorches more than the world around you; it singes your own chances at connection, safety, and meaning. The thrill of destruction fades quickly; the consequences cling far longer than the chaos that caused them. You may take pride in being unpredictable, but unpredictability often isolates more than it empowers. Even storms must rest eventually… and when you stop spinning, you deserve a life that hasn't been reduced to ash.
